definition: Temporal is a platform for durable application workflows that records execution history and coordinates work, retries, and recovery across failures.
entry_text: Temporal is a platform for durable application workflows that records execution history and coordinates work, retries, and recovery across failures.
example: An order workflow resumes after a worker restarts without restarting its completed sequence from the beginning.
label: Temporal.io
sense_note: Temporal.io is the project and vendor website naming.
